description: bymax-qa hooks — qa-guard is a floor under the audit scope while a run is active (.claude/qa/.active present): a network tool in command position may only reach hosts listed in .claude/qa/scope.md allowed-hosts, and a Write/Edit/MultiEdit tool call may only land in this project's .claude/qa/. It is not a full sandbox (an arbitrary Bash file write or an unlisted network binary is the skill's 'never edit the target' discipline). Inert outside an audit; never blocks otherwise.
